newsitem.title: BELGIUM: SOCCER-PLAYERS STRIKE OVER PAY AT BELGIAN CLUB.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PLAYERS STRIKE OVER PAY AT BELGIAN CLUB.

text.p: Players at Belgian second division club Beerschot collectively hung up their boots on Tuesday after not being paid since October.
The players were promised payment last month but the money has yet to materialise.
The management of the club, which is 14th in the division with 22 points from 22 games, promised to rectify the situation as soon as possible.
The players set a deadlime of Tuesday morning and when no one from the management turned up, decided to go on strike.
